reasons: ZoomHighlight re-recorded: fixtures now carry BulletReveal's real artifact builder (fixed pitch, as BulletReveal draws it) instead of the lent arrange() approximation, via the shared fixture_carry_in mechanism
real BulletReveal builder; rows no longer jump at the cut
lens settles beside a narrow target when over the focus it would hide the unfocused parts (example 1 no longer hides hash(key))
structure/geometry split for cross-font stability; theme fonts now installed on the Windows dev box
